name: io.github.crosstabs/likerts
title: Likerts
description: Manage open-source in-product surveys, collections, responses and exports with scoped access.

workspaceId.description: Your Likerts workspace ID, shown in the hosted workspace.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer followed by your workspace's scoped service credential.

environmentVariables.name: LIKERTS_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Your Likerts API origin. Requires HTTPS outside exact loopback development hosts.

environmentVariables.name: LIKERTS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Workspace-bound service credential with only the scopes needed by this agent.

environmentVariables.name: LIKERTS_COLLECTION_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional collection credential for collection configuration and response submission only.
